title: Further Inquiry into Former Minister S Iswaran's Case Given Outcome of Investigations
what_it_is: Further Inquiry into Former Minister S Iswaran's Case Given Outcome of Investigations

sections.label: Iswaran matter and court case
sections.summary: The Prime Minister is asked whether the Iswaran matter needs further consideration, with questions allowed as they do not require answers on issues before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: asked the Prime Minister in view of the outcome of the investigations regarding former Member of Parliament S Iswaran, whether it is necessary to consider the matter further as resolved by this House on the motion moved by Leader of the House and agreed to by this House on 19 September 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Before I call on all the Ministers to reply to Question Nos 23 to 31, I wish to highlight to Members that the Parliamentary Questions (PQs) may be related to a case before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I have allowed the Questions to stand on today's Order Paper because I am satisfied that they do not require answers that venture into legal issues before the Courts nor impinge on the mutual respect and forbearance maintained between this House and the Judiciary.

sections.label: Iswaran investigations, charges and resignation
sections.summary: CPIB completed investigations, the Public Prosecutor charged Mr Iswaran, he resigned and will return salary and allowances, so no further House steps are needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: The Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau (CPIB) has since completed its investigations and the Public Prosecutor has brought charges against Mr Iswaran.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Following his resignation, he also informed the Prime Minister that he would voluntarily return all monies he received by way of Ministerial salary and allowances as an MP that were paid to him since the commencement of the CPIB investigations in July 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: In these circumstances, the specific issues regarding Mr Iswaran, which the House was concerned with, had been addressed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: There is, hence, no need for any further consideration of steps to be taken against Mr Iswaran by the House.

sections.label: Leave of absence and MP allowance
sections.summary: Leave of absence is not an indication of wrongdoing or a sanction, so it would generally not be correct to withhold an MP's allowance during such leave.

sentences.text: Given that leave of absence is not an indication of wrongdoing or a sanction, it would not, as a general rule, be correct to withhold the Members of Parliament's allowance while he or she is on leave of absence.

sections.label: AGC view on criminal charges
sections.summary: Based on their investigations, the AGC has taken the view that there is basis for criminal charges against Mr Iswaran.

sentences.text: Based on their investigations the AGC has taken the view that there is basis for criminal charges to be brought against Mr Iswaran.
